correctness.rationale: Independently traced the exact complex-linear change u=a+b, v=a-b, s=theta/2: N=F_s(u,v)=max_{|r|<=s}|u cos r-i v sin r|. For diagonal Q_y=|u|²+y|v|², pointwise weighted Cauchy–Schwarz and endpoint-attained real-phase lower pairs give M_s(y)=max(1,cos²s+sin²s/y) and m_s(y)=min(1/(1+y),sin²s/y). Direct piecewise minimax establishes unique y*=min(tan²s,1) and squared distortion exactly 2; transforming gives the claimed H² in original a,b. To exclude arbitrary complex cross terms, average positive Hermitian Q under (u,v)->(u,-v); by diagonal uniqueness the averaged optimum equals the normalized Q_s. Equality at (1,±1) forces Re gamma=0; upper boundary contacts (1,±i cot s) for s<=pi/4 or (1,±i) for s>=pi/4 force Im gamma=0. Thus full, not merely diagonal, uniqueness. Computed exact equality-ratio checks at five angles in both regimes independently; finite numerical checks supplement the all-parameter proof. No theta=0 claim.
